gates.name: Pre-registration
gates.rule: Strategy hypothesis, markets, staking, and stop-loss written BEFORE first graded bet. No retroactive edits.

gates.name: Data integrity
gates.rule: Every bet timestamped with model inputs + market price at bet time. Missing timestamps = void.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.rule: Minimum 500 graded bets per market before 'live' status. Below 500 = 'paper' only.

gates.name: CLV gate
gates.rule: Mean CLV > 0 vs closing line with 95% CI excluding 0 (primary skill signal).

gates.name: Calibration gate
gates.rule: Log-loss / Brier beats no-vig market baseline out-of-sample. No calibration = no live.

gates.name: ROI gate
gates.rule: ROI > 0 after vig, with bootstrap CI reported. ROI alone never promotes a strategy.

gates.name: Correlation gate (parlays/props)
gates.rule: Joint probabilities estimated from data; naive multiplication prohibited for SGPs.

gates.name: Risk gate
gates.rule: Max drawdown + staking within approved caps (S-12). Breach = suspension pending review.

scoring.tiebreak: Lower max drawdown, then earlier pre-registration
